notes: Account: telco subsidiary focused on conversational products for enterprise customers.
Primary ask: guaranteed throughput for low-latency voice-first agents during peak windows (10am-2pm PST).
They want reserved GPU pool for production traffic + burst capacity for seasonal spikes.
Security very strict: on-prem gateway for PII routing, audit log retention 7 years, KMS with HSM-backed keys.
Quote from CTO: 'We cannot accept multi-hour outages during call center hours — need firm credits and guaranteed failover.'
AE/SE notes: prepare a 30/60/90 day deployment plan and a fallback model routing strategy if dedicated capacity is saturated.
Customer prefers model family: Llama-variant quantized 8-bit or commercially-similar open family; also asked about Redwood-verified perf profiles.
Cost sensitivity: mid-high; willing to commit to a 12 month reserved contract for price protection but expects SLA credits for downtime beyond threshold.
They requested sample contract language for maintenance windows: monthly 2-hour window preferred, max 6 hours/quarter with 72h notice.
sla_requirements: Target uptime: customer asks 99.99% but willing to accept 99.95% with stronger credit schedule and multi-region fallback
Credit schedule proposed by Redwood: 99.9-99.95% => 10% monthly credit; 99.5-99.9% => 25% credit; <99.5% => 50% credit — customer asking for steeper scale for mission-critical voice flows
Support response times: P1 (service down impacting call center) => 30 minutes initial response, P1 resolution SLA negotiable; P2 (degraded perf) => 4 hours initial response; P3 => 24 hours
Maintenance windows: customer prefers monthly 2-hour window during off-peak; Redwood proposed monthly 4-hour standard with 72h notice and emergency maintenance with 4h notice for critical fixes
Data residency & audit: audit logs retained 7 years, exportable to customer's SIEM on demand; they require KMS separation for key custody
SLA exclusions: agreed-upon list included scheduled maintenance, customer network issues, third-party provider outages; customer pushing for narrower exclusions
gpu_reservation_plan: Requested baseline reserve: 40 A100-equivalent GPUs (or perf-equivalent mix) across two NA regions
Burst pool: additional 8-12 GPUs available with 20% cost premium, automatic burst up to 15 minutes per event
Autoscaling policy: scheduled autoscale for peak PST hours + burst-on-threshold (queue depth + p95 latency triggers)
Run-of-show: 2-week ramp plan with staged traffic shift, shadow traffic for model validation before cutover
performance_targets: Throughput guarantee: sustained 1,200 tokens/sec aggregate at 16k context across reserved pool (customer provided workload trace)
Latency SLOs: p95 <= 120ms token-latency for chat path; p99 <= 250ms under baseline load; voice transcription postproc p95 <= 200ms
Quality: fallbacks must route to quantized compatible variant with <3% delta in key eval prompts; Redwood Optimize to run quantization profiling
